Name: Rainbow Deck
Draw: A repeating lattice of cut rainbow gems set into a near-black ground: four gems across with the rows running on to the top and bottom edges, each the same faceted cushion-cut stone sitting on the same grid, each one refracting the full spectrum in bands of orange, yellow, green, blue and purple across its facets, with bright near-white glints on the upper-left facets and dark violet in the lower pavilion. Thin dark gold lines run between them like the setting of a jeweled panel, so the back reads as one rich, even pattern rather than as gems scattered on a cloth.

Name: Blue Diamond Deck
Draw: A repeating lattice of cut blue diamonds set into a near-black ground: four diamonds across with the rows running on to the top and bottom edges, each the same faceted brilliant-cut stone sitting on the same grid, deep blue at the core and pale icy blue toward the crown, with crisp near-white glints on the upper-left facets and dark navy in the lower pavilion. Thin dark silver lines run between them like the setting of a jeweled panel, so the back reads as one cool, even pattern rather than as stones scattered on a cloth.
